stock.description: China ITS (Holdings) Co., Ltd. operates as an investment holding company, delivering a comprehensive suite of advanced products, tailored solutions, and essential services for critical infrastructure technology both within Mainland China and across international markets. Its operations are structured around two primary divisions: Railway Business and Electric Power Business. The Railway Business segment specializes in providing bespoke solutions, which encompass communication products for railway systems and energy-related offerings. Furthermore, this segment extends its services to include maintenance, network optimization, strategic network planning, and expert technical consulting, all geared towards communication infrastructure for its railway clientele. The Electric Power Business segment focuses on supplying products and customized solutions pertaining to electrical power equipment for entities engaged in power infrastructure construction. This includes vital components like power transmission, transformation, and generation equipment. Beyond equipment supply, the segment is actively involved in power generation operations itself. It also furnishes strategic planning and technical advisory services for electric power infrastructure projects, such as the construction of power plants and modernization of power grids, along with offering value-added operational services covering the investment, development, and ongoing management of power facilities. In addition to its core infrastructure endeavors, the company diversifies its portfolio through real estate development and the leasing of commercial properties, as well as the distribution and sale of electronic goods. Complementing these activities, it also provides specialized technological solutions in communications and surveillance, internet information technology services, and intelligent transportation system (ITS) services. Established in 2008, China ITS (Holdings) Co., Ltd. maintains its corporate headquarters in Beijing, People's Republic of China.
